correctness.rationale: The Leibniz system directly forces block separation; characteristic two gives symmetric zero-row-sum blocks, and nonresonant odd characteristic gives alternating zero-row-sum blocks. Rank-preserving quotient congruence, radical stratification and the bordered-matrix recursion establish the exact formulas for all prime powers. Uniform Gaussian tails establish the asserted total-variation corank laws. Independent brute-force Leibniz-kernel enumeration in the packaged verifier matches all stated test cases. The theorem explicitly excludes the unresolved odd-resonance parameters.
